سياسة الخصوصية

Last updated: October 23, 2026

CommentPull is currently in beta. This policy describes how the service works today, platform by platform: Facebook comments are collected by a browser extension inside your own browser, and YouTube comments are requested from your browser. CommentPull no longer uses the Facebook or Instagram APIs. The full source code is public on GitHub so you can verify these statements yourself.

١. من نحن

CommentPull is a web-based tool, currently in beta, that lets you extract, filter, and export comments from Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube posts. We are the operator of this service, reachable at the contact details at the bottom of this page.

2. Beta status

CommentPull is in beta. Features, data flows and this policy may change as the product evolves, and the service may contain bugs, be interrupted, or return incomplete results. Whenever this policy changes we will update the "Last updated" date. Please do not use the beta for anything critical, and keep your own copy of any results you need to keep.

3. Open source and transparency

The source code of the website, its backend and the browser extension is public at github.com/Arthurdotself/CommentPull. Anyone can inspect how data is handled, and we welcome security reports and corrections. Publishing the code lets you verify what the software is designed to do; it cannot prove what is running on our server at any given moment, so this policy remains our commitment on how we operate the live service.

٢. ما نجمعه

نجمع فقط الحد الأدنى من المعلومات اللازمة لتشغيل حسابك:

  • Account details — your email address and name (entered at sign-up, or provided by Google or GitHub if you sign in with them), used to identify your account and send transactional messages such as password resets.
  • Password — stored only as a bcrypt hash. We never store your plain-text password.
  • Session data and timestamps — your sign-in session, and when your account was created and last updated.
  • Scheduled Exports (optional, Pro) — if you schedule a YouTube export, we store the post URL, the schedule, the YouTube API key needed to run it (encrypted), and the resulting comments (author names, IDs, text, timestamps) until you delete them.
  • Billing (optional) — if you subscribe to a paid plan, we store your plan and your Stripe customer ID. Payments are handled by Stripe.

لا نجمع معلومات الدفع. لا يلزم وجود بطاقة ائتمانية لاستخدام CommentPull.

٣. ما لا نجمعه

  • Facebook (via the browser extension) — the extension runs in your own browser, reads the comments that Facebook shows to your logged-in account, and passes them to the CommentPull page you have open. We do not receive your Facebook password or session, and the comments are not sent to our server.
  • YouTube — you enter your own YouTube Data API key and your browser requests comments from Google directly. The key is not sent to us, except if you create a Pro scheduled export, which needs it to run later.
  • What we do not collect — your Facebook or Google passwords, private messages, or any data outside the posts you ask us to process. We do not run advertising trackers.

6. Browser extension

The CommentPull browser extension is optional and is used for Facebook. It runs only on facebook.com and commentpull.com pages and requests just two browser permissions: activeTab and storage. It collects comment text, author names, profile links and timestamps from the post you open, keeps them in the extension's local storage in your browser until you clear them or start a new run, and hands them to the CommentPull page you have open. It makes no network requests of its own and contains no code that reads your password, cookies or messages. To load more comments it scrolls the page and clicks Facebook's own controls for showing more comments and replies. Because it works on Facebook's pages, using it must also comply with Facebook's terms (see our Terms of Service).

٤. كيف نستخدم بياناتك

  • To authenticate you, keep you signed in and protect your account.
  • To provide the features you use: running scheduled exports and processing subscriptions.
  • To send transactional messages (for example password resets) and answer support requests.
  • To understand aggregate usage and fix problems while the service is in beta.

لا نبيع أو نؤجر أو نشارك بياناتك الشخصية مع أطراف ثالثة لأغراض تسويقية.

٥. ملفات تعريف الارتباط والجلسات

When you sign in we set one HTTP-only, secure cookie (cp_token) that contains a random session token — not your password. The web app also keeps that session token, your display name and your language and filter preferences in your browser's local storage so it can call our API. Sessions expire after 30 days or when you sign out. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking cookies.

٦. التحليلات

نستخدم Google Analytics 4 لفهم كيفية استخدام التطبيق بشكل إجمالي (مثل أي علامة تبويب الأكثر شيوعاً، وعدد عمليات الاستخراج الناجحة). هذه البيانات مجهولة الهوية وغير مرتبطة بحسابك. يمكنك إلغاء الاشتراك عبر الإضافات التي تحجب Google Analytics.

٧. تخزين البيانات وأمانها

Account data is stored in a MySQL database hosted on Hostinger. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt; YouTube API keys that we must keep for scheduled exports are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before they are stored; session tokens are random 256-bit values; and the site is served over HTTPS. No system is perfectly secure, and because the service is in beta we cannot promise uninterrupted or breach-free operation.

Comments are stored on our servers only if you create a Scheduled Export (Pro). Otherwise they stay in your browser and in the files you download.

٨. الاحتفاظ بالبيانات

Account data is kept while your account is active. Scheduled exports remain until you delete them or delete your account. You can delete your account yourself from Settings — this removes your profile, sessions, scheduled exports and stored API keys — or email us and we will delete your data within 7 days.

٩. حقوقك

اعتماداً على موقعك، قد يكون لديك حقوق بموجب GDPR أو CCPA أو قوانين مماثلة، بما في ذلك:

  • الحق في الوصول إلى البيانات التي نحتفظ بها عنك.
  • الحق في تصحيح البيانات غير الدقيقة.
  • الحق في حذف حسابك وجميع البيانات المرتبطة به.
  • الحق في إمكانية نقل البيانات — نسخة من بياناتك بتنسيق يمكن قراءته آلياً.
  • الحق في سحب الموافقة في أي وقت.

لممارسة أي من هذه الحقوق، تواصل معنا على البريد الإلكتروني أدناه.

١٠. خدمات الطرف الثالث

  • Meta (Facebook & Instagram) — Facebook pages you open when using the browser extension are served by Meta. Subject to Meta's Privacy Policy.
  • Google — YouTube Data API v3 (called from your browser), Google sign-in and Google Analytics. Subject to Google's Privacy Policy.
  • GitHub — sign-in with GitHub, and hosting of our public source code. Subject to GitHub's Privacy Statement.
  • Stripe — payment processing for paid plans. Subject to Stripe's Privacy Policy.
  • Hostinger — our hosting provider stores account data in their data centres. Subject to Hostinger's Privacy Policy.

١١. التغييرات على هذه السياسة

قد نقوم بتحديث سياسة الخصوصية هذه من وقت لآخر. عند القيام بذلك، سنراجع تاريخ "آخر تحديث" في الأعلى. يُعدّ استمرار استخدام CommentPull بعد نشر التغييرات قبولاً للسياسة المحدَّثة.

يمكن إرسال الأسئلة وطلبات البيانات وطلبات الحذف إلى:
